title: Reverse-engineering a NAS LED controller
text: Reverse-engineers the LED controller of a consumer NAS box and writes a small daemon that sets the status lights properly under Linux.

title: Ghidra documentation of a device serial protocol
text: Runs headless Ghidra over a device's firmware image and produces documentation of its internal serial protocol.

title: Patching monitor firmware to remove wake banner
text: Decompiles and patches a new monitor's firmware to remove a pop-up banner shown on every wake, taking several attempts without bricking it.

title: Pico firmware to inject HDMI CEC messages
text: Writes Pi Pico firmware, wired into an adapter, that injects HDMI-CEC messages at the right moment so a budget game console can control a TV.

title: New desktop app for a USB microscope
text: Decompiles a USB microscope's mobile app, probes the device to learn why it is not a standard webcam, and writes a desktop app for it.

title: Tracing odd behavior through microcontroller firmware
text: Points a disassembler at embedded device firmware with a description of unexpected behavior, traces the command path, and keeps notes on firmware structure for follow-up questions.

title: Debloating a smart TV and replacing its launcher
text: Finds a TV on the network from its product number, removes 25 vendor packages, and installs a new minimalist launcher.

title: Probing Bluetooth RGB lights and documenting the protocol
text: Scans nearby Bluetooth devices, finds an unsecured set of RGB lights, runs a rainbow effect on them, and documents the control protocol.

title: Bluetooth LED panel as a status display
text: Writes a Rust program that pushes GIF frames over Bluetooth to a cheap 64x64 LED matrix panel to display coding-session status.

title: Sniffing a smart ring protocol for webhooks
text: Sniffs Bluetooth traffic and reads the companion app package to draft a protocol spec for a smart ring, then turns its pinch gesture into webhooks.

title: Extracting a Bluetooth device protocol from its APK
text: Decompiles a vendor APK to extract a clean protocol specification for a Bluetooth device, then implements a local CLI client for it.

title: Replacing an RV control app via Bluetooth
text: Reverse-engineers the Bluetooth protocol of an RV control system from its vendor app, then builds a replacement Android app, website and Home Assistant integration.

title: Wire-protocol reverse engineering with a knowledge base
text: Reverse-engineers the wire protocol of an expensive hardware device using a written plan file and a facts-only knowledge file that every next step must be justified against.

title: Jailbroken Kindle as a photo frame
text: Jailbreaks an unused e-reader and builds software that turns it into a rotating art frame.

title: Native Node.js build on a jailbroken iPhone
text: Builds Node.js from source on a jailbroken iPhone, cutting build size from 29GB to under 8GB, so a coding assistant runs natively on the phone.

title: Unlocking a cheap tablet bootloader
text: Identifies a budget tablet's chipset, finds a known vulnerability, and unlocks its bootloader over ADB and fastboot, preparing the way for mainline Linux.

title: E-ink displays running local dashboards
text: Flashes small e-ink screens with open firmware and writes backends that render daily book quotes, pulled from a jailbroken e-reader, onto them over the local network.

title: Decompiling competitor effects pedals' firmware
text: Emulates original pedal firmware ROMs, then converts the audio algorithms into a standalone C++ library and checks its output against the emulator.

title: Decoding a player piano's MP3 format
text: Decodes a self-playing piano's proprietary MP3 format, finding MIDI in one channel plus decoy notes, and writes an encoder and decoder for it.

title: Pico firmware turning a car gadget wireless
text: Builds Pi Pico firmware and a custom Linux image so a discontinued car gadget can run on home Wi-Fi without a phone or PC.

title: Smart TV strip-down over Wi-Fi
text: Removes a smart TV maker's ad-serving and tracking apps from Android TV sets over Wi-Fi and installs a plain launcher showing only chosen apps.

title: RF remote decoding for a swamp cooler
text: Captures a cooler's RF remote signals, decodes them, and builds a controller that sends cool commands to hold indoor humidity in a target range.

title: Mapping a smart sleep mask's protocol
text: Scans for Bluetooth devices, decompiles a Flutter companion app, maps fifteen device commands, and builds a web control panel, then finds the vendor's cloud broker open.

title: Fixing a capture card's HDMI color bug
text: Analyzes firmware, an HDMI receiver driver and debug UART output from a discontinued video capture card to pinpoint a color-mode bug that makes video turn green and pink.

title: Custom apps for cheap smart glasses
text: Reverse-engineers the Bluetooth link of budget smart glasses and builds an app that runs custom features within the glasses' firmware limits.

title: Debian image for a budget Android tablet
text: Reverse-engineers a cheap Android tablet with no vendor documentation and builds a bootable Debian image that runs from an SD card.

title: Linux driver for a binary-only capture dongle
text: Writes a Linux driver for a VGA-to-USB capture device whose only vendor driver is an old binary build, so it works with modern kernels.

title: Water monitor radio protocol decoding
text: Dumps the firmware of a water-flow monitor's bridge to extract its key and reverse-engineers the radio protocol to build a local receiver for sensor readings.

title: Ventilation unit UART controller for Home Assistant
text: Writes an ESPHome component that speaks UART to a home ventilation unit and exposes it as a controllable fan in a smart-home dashboard.

title: Old phone as a postmarketOS cluster node
text: Unlocks the bootloader of an old Android phone, rebuilds a postmarketOS image several times with kernel flags enabled, and turns it into a Kubernetes node.

title: Unbricking a digital piano via app decompile
text: Decompiles a piano maker's Android app to find the hardcoded firmware encryption key, decrypts the update, and writes a Bluetooth flashing script that revives a bricked piano.

title: Libraries for cheap USB and Wi-Fi endoscopes
text: Reverse-engineers Android-only USB and Wi-Fi endoscopes and develops Python and Arduino libraries, flashed and tested with the hardware in the loop.

title: Decompiling a camera lens firmware updater
text: Scripts a decompiler to open a camera lens's firmware updater program, then explores the decompiled code directly to see how the update works.

title: Cross-platform editor for a 1990s synthesizer
text: Examines a synthesizer's legacy editing software in a disassembler to decode its undocumented sysex wave-transfer protocol, then builds a modern cross-platform editor for it.

title: Prometheus exporter for a printer status page
text: Parses the HTML status page of a network laser printer, which replaced its old CSV page after a firmware update, into a Prometheus exporter for toner and page counts.

title: Rooting an old Fire TV stick
text: Researches kernel sources and exploits for a first-generation streaming stick, roots it permanently, removes preinstalled apps, and downgrades its firmware.

title: macOS driver for an unsupported USB gamepad
text: Researches a USB gamepad's proprietary protocol, writes a macOS driver, and tests it so the controller works on a Mac.

title: Fast photo transfer app for a mirrorless camera
text: Reverse-engineers a camera maker's Bluetooth and Wi-Fi transfer protocol and builds a native Mac and iOS app that pulls photos in seconds using concurrent downloads.

title: Linux sensor reader for a case LED display
text: Probes a PC case display's sensor data to reverse-engineer its Windows-only companion software, then writes a Linux program that shows GPU and CPU temperatures.

title: Replacing a smart camera's cloud service
text: Replaces a home camera's subscription backend with a local pipeline that sends frames to image-recognition software for detection.

title: Smart speakers from restored vintage radios
text: Replaces the electronics of old radios with a Raspberry Pi and microphone array, rewrites the backend, and builds a first-run setup like commercial smart speakers.

title: Golf launch monitor Bluetooth simulator
text: Builds a Swift app that reads shot data from a golf launch monitor over Bluetooth and feeds a local web app showing shot arcs, video and metrics.

title: Reverse-engineering a VR headset's firmware
text: Reverse-engineers the firmware of a consumer VR headset, resuming on its own after an initial stop because the hardware belongs to the user.

title: CNC jog pendant integration
text: Reverse-engineers a wireless CNC pendant's protocol and writes an integration that lets it drive a CNC controller like a manual mill.

title: Running custom models on a cheap camera's accelerator
text: Reverse-engineers the neural-network accelerator inside a budget Wi-Fi camera chip, then builds an ONNX compiler and runtime so it runs custom models.

title: Face-tracking autofocus add-on for a camera
text: Builds a pipeline from a camera's HDMI output through an edge computing board that sends USB control commands, adding face-aware focus beyond the built-in autofocus.

title: Desktop Linux stack on a jailbroken iPad
text: Compiles and runs Wayland, X11, GNOME, KDE and a browser natively on a jailbroken iPad, documenting the results in a wiki.

title: Replacement insert for a smart-glasses case
text: Reverse-engineers the geometry of a smart-glasses charging case to design a 3D-printed insert less likely to break, converting 3D problems into 2D ones.

title: Garmin watch showing external running metrics
text: Makes a sports watch display running dynamics sent from a microcontroller board as if they were native sensor data, using sample values to test the approach.

title: Rooting a discontinued smart display
text: Reverse-engineers a discontinued smart display over 18 days, building a partial exploit chain from browser and kernel research, to repurpose it before the work stalls at 85 percent.

title: Obfuscated Bluetooth OBD reader protocol via Frida
text: Reverse-engineers a Bluetooth car-diagnostics reader's protocol from an obfuscated companion app, using an emulator and dynamic instrumentation, so the device can be used from Python.

title: Remote Kobo management over SSH
text: Connects over SSH to an e-reader to fetch a blog post, convert it to the reader's book format, and add it to the library on request.

title: Pebble watch face modernization
text: Updates a decade-old smartwatch face codebase so it runs on the newest watch hardware, then publishes the bitcoin and weather watch face.

title: Calorie display for a Garmin watch
text: Builds a Garmin watch app that shows calories consumed, writing the on-device code and companion sync as described in a blog post.

title: Fridge-magnet shopping list on an e-ink board
text: Writes about 2,400 lines of C++ firmware for an ESP32 e-ink touchscreen board that syncs a shopping list with a phone web app over Wi-Fi.

title: Jailbreaking Kindles and a car gadget
text: Jailbreaks several e-readers and a discontinued car gadget, then adds them to a home setup, with a Raspberry Pi driving the gadget.

title: Reimplementing Bluetooth controller firmware from a blob
text: Reverse-engineers a binary blob of Bluetooth controller firmware and reimplements it, continuing the work without refusals.

title: Stripping spyware from an Android TV over ADB
text: Connects to an Android TV over ADB and removes the spyware components it can find.

title: Remote configuration of a Kindle over Tailscale
text: Sets up a private-network proxy on an e-reader and enables remote SSH, so settings can be configured remotely without touching the device.

title: Single-purpose flashcard device from an e-ink reader
text: Turns a small e-ink reader into a dedicated flashcard learning device by writing custom software that replaces its general reading interface.

title: Stripping ads from a family streaming TV
text: Connects over the network to a family member's Android TV, removes ad-serving apps, and installs a cleaner home screen.
